instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application inside `/app/frontend/src/App.js` and associated components.
Ensure dark purple theme matches user preference: #08050D primary background, glowing violet (#8B5CF6) accents, dark purple card panels (#160F24).
Implement the bilingual ES/EN language switcher in header/hero that seamlessly re-renders all headings, subheadings, badges, feature titles, and download buttons.
Implement a real APK download mechanism (serves a dummy file `/velora-app-v2.4.0.apk` or triggers synthetic browser download with file blob and triggers installation instruction drawer).
Include a tasteful 18+ age verification banner/modal or warning tag to satisfy adult positioning with high sophistication.
Ensure all buttons, tabs, links, modals, language toggles, and key text blocks include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Use Framer Motion for scroll entrance animations, bento card hover glows, and mobile screen tabs.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur filters for headers or sticky elements.
